notes.title: Lust For Speed in Early Acccess!
notes.content:
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40644311/38ab05f9ec6b8f17a30d7f894d6ae09a94ecdaa1.png"]

Hey everyone!
I’m beyond excited to finally announce that the game is launching in Early Access!

I’m literally shaking from excitement and fear.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1535110/Lust_for_Speed/


This game has been through development hell, fought off all the demons there, and somehow made it out alive — straight into Early Access!

Just a reminder: this is a dating sim with street racing, where you grab a badass ride, tune it to the max, and crush some hot Racer-Ladies — and if you charm them well enough, you might even Fuck em!


[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40644311/379a537a31a014edabec8ae2a605ae39bafbd8c8.jpg"]

You can even add your own custom vinyls to your ride!
[olist]
 Right-click the game in your Steam Library → Manage → Browse local files
 Open the folder LustForSpeed_EA_Data
 Inside it, find the UserVinyls folder
 Drop your images there!
 In-game, create a new vinyl and open the “User” category
 Make it White
[/olist]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40644311/59461d3fbab33522689c302309f4e1b78efea0d8.jpg"]

If you want your unique vinyl to be added into the game — feel free to send it to me, for example at afftarmudac@gmail.com

The image should be PNG with transparency.
It can be fully white (for coloring in-game) 
Or already colored.
No partial transparency — the engine will Clip it as fully transparent.

That’s all for now!
Looking forward to your feedback, bug reports, suggestions, reviews and ideas — all in the Steam Community section!

See you there!
